checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'learnings-log'.

checks.description: The log is appended to, never overwritten.
checks.rule: Body requires reading the existing log first and appending only, never overwriting, deleting, or reordering prior entries.

checks.description: Each learning entry carries learning, evidence, campaign_id, date.
checks.rule: Body and template define each entry with learning, evidence, campaign_id, and date fields.

checks.description: Returns the reference the campaign-report records as learnings_log_ref.
checks.rule: Body states the skill returns a learnings_log_ref (file and anchor) for the campaign-report.

checks.description: Learnings tie to the success_metric, not vanity metrics.
checks.rule: Body requires each learning to tie to the success_metric the strategy set, never a vanity metric or a metric invented after the fact.

checks.description: Learnings stay portable, no invented specifics.
checks.rule: Body requires learnings to be portable with no invented offer, price, Skill Path title, or instructor name.
templates/learnings-log.md exists and shows an append-only entry with learning, evidence, campaign_id, and date.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the skill files.
checks.rule: No file in this skill contains the U+2014 em dash character.
No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) appear in any file; digits are 0-9 only.

checks.description: No tatweel or kashida in any Arabic text.
checks.rule: No file contains the U+0640 tatweel character.
